attempts.text:
Deferring an adult costs 20, so I compared each pickup's driving time with the penalties it would avoid. The car starts at the shelter, which is also the only evacuation point, so every pickup is a round trip.

| Option | Driving | Penalties avoided | Worth it? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kalika farm (3 adults) | 14 min (7 each way) | 60 | Yes |
| Dupcheshwar market (1 adult) | 64 min (32 each way) | 20 | No |
| Uttargaya farm and Dupcheshwar market (3 adults, one trip via the market) | 110 min (55 each way) | 60 | No |

Kalika farm connects only to the shelter, so it can't be combined with the other pickups.

The best plan is to rescue the 3 adults at Kalika farm and defer the other 3 adults to a later wave.

**Total cost:** 14 minutes of driving + 60 in penalties (3 × 20) = 74

<plan>
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter kalika-farm
load car1 adult 3
drive car1 kalika-farm shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 adult 3
defer dupcheshwar-market adult 1
defer uttargaya-farm adult 2
</plan>

COST: 74
